verdict.rationale: Speechmatics documents a batch API for turning audio files into text, with job resources that can be deleted. It also offers SDKs, an agent-readable llms.txt (probe HTTP 200), and markdown API reference pages, so an agent with a key plausibly has a docs-only path from submission to transcript. However, the pack never shows the batch job-creation call, status polling, transcript retrieval or the auth header format, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. Missing for 10: explicit documented batch job-creation and transcript-retrieval endpoints, documented API-key auth scheme for batch, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, hands-on corroboration that an agent completed the flow unaided.
